verdict.rationale: Aleph documents budget planning and tracking, board-ready variance analysis, and an AI analyst (Scan) that runs flux/variance analysis and suggests drill dimensions such as vendor. It also claims drill-down in its Excel/Sheets workflows and clickable cited sources that trace answers back to source data. However, the evidence never explicitly describes budget-vs-actuals cut by department and account, or drilling from a variance down to the underlying transactions. missing for 10: explicit budget-vs-actuals reporting by department and account, documented transaction-level drill-down from a variance, independent or hands-on corroboration.
